name: sequential
source: The clerk receives the request. The clerk archives the request.

name: approval_rejection
source: The manager reviews the request. If approved, the clerk orders goods. Otherwise, the clerk closes the request.

name: multi_stage
source: The clerk checks the request. If valid, the manager reviews it; otherwise it is closed. If approved, the clerk orders goods; otherwise it is closed.

name: missing_branch
source: The manager reviews the request. If approved, the clerk closes it.

name: unstated_actor
source: Receive the request. Close the request.

name: unreachable
source: The clerk receives and closes a request. An audit state is also mentioned without an entry route.

name: dead_end
source: The clerk receives a request and reviews it. The procedure stops without explaining completion.

name: bypass
source: The clerk receives a request. The clerk can close it directly or route it through review first.

name: cycle
source: The clerk receives a request. The clerk reviews it repeatedly until accepted, then closes it.

name: ambiguous
source: Someone handles the request as appropriate.
